{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The People of Puerto Rico have been bravely fighting on the streets for the last 13 days to demand the resignation of the current Governor, Ricardo Rosselló.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Puerto Rico is giving a lesson in struggle and solidarity.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America recognize the incredible hardships that the Puerto Rican people have faced in the last three years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The hardships faced by the Puerto Rican people are in large part because of the oppressive colonial relationship between the archipelago and the US that is now more than 120 years old.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America have been amazed at the power of solidarity and the strength Puerto Ricans have shown in order to take care of each other and defend and rebuild their communities and their country.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America understand that the challenges Puerto Rico faces are not just the result of a corrupt governor.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America stand in solidarity with the Puerto Rican people in their fight to oust Governor Rosselló.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America support the right of the Puerto Rican people to a fair, autonomous and democratic process to establish a new government.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Puerto Rican people have risen in protest against the abuse of power, the humiliations, the corruption and the hate that has come from the Governor and his close allies and other government officials.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
